symptom: PC in VLAN 30 gets IP but cannot reach server in same VLAN.
topology_note: Access switch SW1 connects PC3 on Fa0/12 and server on Fa0/20.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: PC access port is in the wrong VLAN.
evidence: show vlan brief: VLAN 30 missing Fa0/12; Fa0/12 listed in VLAN 1
show interfaces fa0/12 switchport: Access Mode VLAN: 1
fix_steps: Set Fa0/12 to access VLAN 30 and verify with show vlan brief.
Record human review decision before closing the case.

human_review.reviewer_note: Diagnosis is supported by the show-command evidence and the fix is specific.

verification.post_fix_check: Original connectivity test passes and show output confirms corrected configuration.
